tools.name: eu_fx
tools.description: Use for euro exchange rates: ECB reference rates or cross rates via EUR (optional base, symbols, amount, date) with change versus the previous publication (calculated by P0) and a stale flag. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /eu/fx, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL wit

tools.name: eu_fx_history
tools.description: Use for a short euro exchange rate history: daily ECB reference rates of one currency against EUR for up to the last 30 days, with min, max, mean and percent change. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /eu/fx/history, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP c

tools.name: rates_reference
tools.description: Use when an agent needs an official interest-rate benchmark with its date and source: SOFR (NY Fed), euro short-term rate (ECB, series=estr) or US Treasury par yield curve (series=ust, default 10y). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /rates/reference, $0.002 per call; schema linked).

tools.description: Use when you need a weather forecast for a latitude/longitude anywhere in the world: hourly temperature, wind speed and direction, humidity, pressure, cloud cover. tools.name: hazards_near
tools.description: Use when you need natural-hazard context for a site by latitude/longitude: active NWS alerts at the point (US only), USGS earthquakes and open NASA EONET events. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /hazards/near, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client

tools.name: hazards_near_batch
tools.description: Use when you need to screen several sites for natural hazards at once: up to 10 'lat,lon' points in one POST, each answered exactly like /hazards/near. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (POST /hazards/near/batch, $0.05 per call; schema linked). POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "fx-rates-news-weather-data" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: eu_fx, eu_fx_history, rates_reference, news_latest, weather, hazards_near, hazards_near_batch, knowledge_search · Public sink: hazards_near_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: eu_fx, eu_fx_history, rates_reference, news_latest, weather, hazards_near, hazards_near_batch, knowledge_search · Public sink: hazards_near_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "eu_fx" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
